assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease and intermittent symptomatic arrhythmias.
The service is documented in the indication note.
The service supports the diagnosis codes I49.5, I25.10, and I47.1.
